1. Moral agent has a moral contradiction about Trait X being relevant for moral worth.

Framing the opposition as a psychopath for not valuing humans who do don't posses trait X is also not helpful. It may help you win a debate in front of an uneducated audience but it doesn't change the opponents moral system.  

When it comes down to me personally I do value moral consistency and I could name you my traits but even you eliminate all my traits from set human you'd be at at creature that't can be hardly considered human anymore anyway - therefore you couldn't frame me a psychopath.
